analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 33.6 to 48.6, signaling an exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -2.5488 to -0.3024, confirming bottoming action. The current price of $696.00 relative to the 5-day low of $675.30 forms a Higher Low pattern. With ADX at 16.6, indicating a non-trending phase, a wait-and-see approach is maintained, mindful of potential shock-like volatility.
